reason: The policy's 'Modify items' section permits modifying items to 'an available new item of the same product but of different product option,' requiring replacement items. The tool call provides three item_ids but an empty new_item_ids array, creating a parameter mismatch. The tool's schema requires each new item to match the corresponding old item in position and product type. The policy does not support selective item removal from an order—it supports either cancelling the entire order (with a specific reason) or modifying items to different variants. Removing specific items while keeping others exceeds the stated scope.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
